windows.validation_note: Untouched by every choice of this protocol (bars, configuration, calibration, tier parameters). Its outcomes were read once before by the P9 v6/v7 holdout replay (2026-04-01..2026-11-08) with other predictions and other rules: reported as 'validation, outcomes previously seen by earlier rules', never as proof (owner 2026-11-17: only live tips prove a cell).

bars.method: src.bars_opt.study unchanged (pre-registered selection: per family the configuration chosen by nested inner validation on the fit window, per league its OWN bars - never global - with MODEL vs LEAGUE_WIDE switch), run_select on fit, run_final once on validation
bars.proven_rule: PROVEN = >= 150 validation bets AND Holm-adjusted one-sided p < 0.025 AND matchday-block-bootstrap 95% CI lower bound > 0 (Holm family = every cell tested on the validation window + every configuration searched); PROMISING = validation ROI > 0 and CLV > 0 (or no CLV); else UNPROVEN; OFF with its reason
bars.serving_cells: src.bars_opt.cells.build on every priced row before 2026-11-01 (allow_blend, OFF rules unchanged) with the validation verdicts -> threshold_proposals candidates -> one proposal id

tiers.pool: per (track, league, ISO week): tips of MODEL-mode cells clearing their cell's VALUABLE bar. LEAGUE_WIDE cells are not in the pool (own list, as live). Distinct fixture x market; one goal direction per fixture (BTTS Yes = OVER).
tiers.calibration: R2 of protocol v6: p_cal = fair + lam * (p_used - fair), lam per cell (track, league, market-side) = the study's shrink weight of the cell's own slope inside its league (src.research.top3_ranking._lams, >= 40 priced rows), fitted ONLY on rows dated before the pool's period (inner block start / 2026-09-01 / serving: 2026-11-09). cal_ev = p_cal * odds - 1. ev_lo = (fair + (lam - lam_se) * (p_used - fair)) * odds - 1.
tiers.T1_BEST_VALUE: the pool tip with the highest cal_ev
tiers.T2_SAFEST: of the rest, the tip with the highest p_cal
tiers.T3_RISKY_VALUE: of the rest, odds >= the league's T3 odds floor, highest ev_lo; floor REL = the rest's longest-odds tip

gates.BAR: every tier needs the cell's own value: cleared bar AND p_used * odds - 1 > 0 (cal_ev ranks only)

tiers.fit_pool: inner out-of-sample bets of the fit window: for every inner block (study.inner_blocks: 5 equal matchday blocks, blocks 2..5 scored) the family's chosen configuration and bars are refitted on rows before the block and applied to it; lam refitted on the same earlier rows
tiers.choice: per (track, league): gate = argmax of (mean pnl - 1 SE) over all tiers' fit picks (T3 = REL while choosing the gate), a gate needs >= 40 fit picks; none -> CAL, labelled UNFITTED; T3 floor = argmax of (mean pnl - 1 SE) of the fit T3 picks among candidates with >= 40 fit T3 picks, else REL, labelled UNFITTED (REL is a definition - the week's longest-odds value tip - not a fitted number). SE = study.max_se (largest of independent / matchday / ISO-week block SE). No global value is fitted; the grids are declared here.
tiers.never_pad: a tier without a qualifying tip stays EMPTY; every league-week with < 3 tips gets a cause: NO_FIXTURES, ALL_CELLS_OFF, NO_PRICE, NO_CALIBRATION, NO_VALUE, FEW_VALUE (1-2 value tips), T3_EMPTY, RULE_CONFLICT
tiers.stake: unchanged owner decision 2026-11-17: 0.5% flat on every TOP-3 tip, placed manually; this protocol does not change stakes

reporting.stats: bets, hit rate, ROI, matchday-block bootstrap 95% CI, CLV (B1 / own closing pair) where available, mean odds
